demoNote: Synthetic international flight demo data is added only on first use. Additions, edits and deletions are saved locally in this browser.
flightsDescription: Unified flight bookings, journey segments, seats, fares and payment fields.
storageError: Local data could not be read or saved. Previous data was not replaced; check browser storage.
pricingNote: Per-passenger and total fares are separate source fields. Excel may display a rounded per-passenger fare, so the total is not recalculated from it.
search: Search booking, airline, route or flight number
saveError: Could not save the request. Check its fields, storage, or duplicate booking.

errors.required: Enter a valid value up to 200 characters
errors.date: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD
errors.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code such as EUR
errors.number: Enter a positive number within the allowed range
errors.value: Enter a valid value. Counts must be whole numbers and amounts cannot be negative.

categoryDescription: Area for entering and managing operational data.
categoryPending: Fields and import rules for this section will be defined when its data sample is available.
noCategoryRecords: No data has been added to this section yet
manualNote: Enter the available fields only. A booking reference or flight number is required. Amounts are recorded as entered, without automatic calculations.
paymentNote: Optional source summary fields. Country totals are not automatically assigned to this booking.
identityRequired: Enter a booking reference or a flight number in a journey segment.
